basinc.label: Against or In favour of a basic income scheme
basinc.question: CARD 54 | Some countries are currently talking about introducing a basic income scheme. In a moment I will ask you to tell me whether you are against or in favour of this scheme. First, I will give you some more details. The highlighted box at the top of this card shows the main features of the scheme. A basic income scheme includes all of the following: ...READ OUT...- The government pays everyone a monthly income to cover essential living costs. - It replaces many other social benefits. - The purpose is to guarantee everyone a minimum standard of living. - Everyone receives the same amount regardless of whether or not they are working. - People also keep the money they earn from work or other sources. - This scheme is paid for by taxes. INTERVIEWER: PAUSE TO GIVE THE RESPONDENT TIME TO READ CARD. have two children who share a birthday, please answer the questions for the one whose name comes first alphabetically. | Is this child male or female? | INTERVIEWER: If the respondent has more than one son or daughter with the same birthday, ask them to think of the son or daughter whose name comes first alphabetically.

gndro12b.label: Gender of child aged 12 or over
gndro12b.question: ASK IF RESPONDENT HAS 1 CHILD AGED 12 OR OVER AT G10 (IF G10 = 1) | Is this child male or female? |

ageo12.label: Age of child aged 12 or over
ageo12.question: ASK IF MALE, FEMALE OR REFUSAL AT G11a OR G11b (IF G11a = 1, 2, 7 OR G11b = 1, 2, 7) | How old is he/she? | INTERVIEWER: Accept the respondent's estimate if they cannot provide an exact age.

hhlio12.label: Child aged 12 or over lives in same household
hhlio12.question: Does he/she live in the same household as you? | Please answer ‘Yes’ if he/she lives with you sometimes.

closeo12.label: How close to child aged 12 or over
closeo12.question: CARD 63 | Taking everything into consideration, how close do you feel to him/her?

ttmino12.label: Travel time to child aged 12 or over, in minutes
ttmino12.question: ASK IF NO AT G13 (IF G13 = 2) | About how long would it take you to get to where he/she lives, on average? | Think of the way you would travel and of the time it would take door to door.

speako12.label: Speak with child aged 12 or over in person, how often
speako12.question:
ASK IF MALE, FEMALE OR REFUSAL AT G11a OR G11b (IF G11a = 1, 2, 7 OR G11b = 1, 2, 7)
CARD 64 | How often do you speak with him/her in person? | Please only include occasions where you are physically in the same location.

como12.label: Communicate with child aged 12 or over via text, email or messaging apps, how often
como12.question: STILL CARD 64 | How often do you communicate in writing with each other via text, email or messaging apps?

scrno12.label: Speak with child aged 12 or over and see each other on a screen, how often
scrno12.question: STILL CARD 64 | How often do you speak with him/her such that you can see each other on a screen?

phoneo12.label: Speak with child aged 12 or over using a phone, how often
phoneo12.question: STILL CARD 64 | How often do you speak with him/her using a phone or other device? | Please include calls you make or receive, but exclude calls where you see each other on a screen.

livpnt.label: Parents still alive
livpnt.question: We are aware that the question below might be sensitive, but your answer is needed to make sure that you are directed to the correct questions later on in the questionnaire. | Are any of your parents still alive? | Please think only about your biological parents.

pntmofa.label: Parents still alive, mother or father
pntmofa.question: ASK IF BOTH PARENTS ALIVE AT G22 (IF G22 = 1) | Are you answering the following questions about your mother or your father? | INTERVIEWER: If the respondent has more than one parent with the same birthday, ask them to think of the parent whose name comes first alphabetically.

agepnt.label: Age of parent
agepnt.question: ASK IF MOTHER OR FATHER AT G22, OR MOTHER, FATHER OR REFUSAL AT G23 (IF G22 = 2, 3 OR G23 = 1, 2, 7 | How old is he/she? | Please give an estimate if you are unsure.

hhlipnt.label: Parent lives in same household
hhlipnt.question: Does he/she live in the same household as you? | Please answer ‘Yes’ if he/she lives with you sometimes.

closepnt.label: How close to parent
closepnt.question: CARD 66 | Taking everything into consideration, how close do you feel to him/her?

ttminpnt.label: Travel time to parent, in minutes
ttminpnt.question: About how long would it take you to get to where he/she lives, on average? | Think of the way you would travel and of the time it would take door to door.

speakpnt.label: Speak with parent in person, how often
speakpnt.question:
ASK IF MOTHER OR FATHER AT G22, OR MOTHER, FATHER OR REFUSAL AT G23 (IF G22 = 2, 3 OR G23 = 1, 2, 7)
CARD 67 | How often do you speak with him/her in person? | Please only include occasions where you are physically in the same location.

compnt.label: Communicate with parent via text, email or messaging apps, how often

scrnpnt.label: Speak with parent and see each other on a screen, how often

phonepnt.label: Speak with parent using a phone, how often
phonepnt.question: STILL CARD 67 | How often do you speak with him/her using a phone or other device? | Please include calls you make or receive, but exclude calls where you see each other on a screen.

wrkhome.question: CARD 71 | How often do you work from home or from another place of your choice during your regular working hours?

wrklong.label: Employees expected to work overtime, how often

The next few questions are about the organisation or company you work in.
CARD 73 | If you work in an organisation, how often are employees in your organisation expected to work overtime, whether at the workplace or at home?

values.category: I don't work in an organisation

wrkresp.label: Employees expected to be responsive outside working hours, how often
wrkresp.question:
ASK IF RESPONDENT DID NOT REPORT NOT WORKING IN AN ORGANISATION AT G41 (IF G41 = 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 77, 88)
STILL CARD 73 | How often are employees in your organisation expected to be responsive to work communications outside working hours?

scrhlm.label: Respondent have a line manager
scrhlm.question: Do you have a line manager?

sclmsup.label: Line manager supports employees in balancing work, how much
sclmsup.question: How much does your line manager support employees in balancing work and personal commitments?

mansupp.label: Line manager supports employees in balancing work, how much
mansupp.question:
ASK IF CURRENTLY IN PAID WORK AT F17a OR F18 (IF 01 AT F17a OR F18 = 1)
CARD 75 | If you have a line manager, how much does he or she support employees in balancing work and personal commitments? | Please choose a number from 0 to 10, where 0 means not at all and 10 means completely.
INTERVIEWER: Line manager refers to the person the respondent receives work instructions from on a regular basis; if the respondent has several line managers, ask them to think of the one they received work instructions from most recently. This applies to all questions referring to the respondent’s line manager in this module.

values.category: I don't have a line manager

manhlp.label: Line manager gives work-related help, how likely
manhlp.question:
ASK IF RESPONDENT DID NOT REPORT HAVING NO LINE MANAGER AT G44 (IF G44 = 00, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 77, 88)
CARD 76 | How likely would your line manager be to give you work-related help or advice, if needed?

manwrkpl.question: CARD 77 | How often are you and your line manager at the same workplace at the same time? | Same workplace means the same physical location.

values.category: I don't have a regular workplace

manspeak.label: Speak with line manager about work in person, how often
manspeak.question: Please only include occasions where you are physically in the same location. | How often do you speak about work with your line manager in person?

mancom.label: Communicate with line manager about work via text, email or messaging apps, how often
mancom.question: STILL CARD 78 | How often do you communicate about work in writing with your line manager via text, email or messaging apps?

manscrn.label: Speak with line manager about work and see each other on a screen, how often
manscrn.question: STILL CARD 78 | How often do you speak about work with your line manager such that you can see each other on a screen?

manphone.label: Speak with line about work manager using a phone, how often
manphone.question: STILL CARD 78 | How often do you speak about work with your line manager using a phone or other device? | Please include calls you make or receive, but exclude calls where you see each other on a screen.

teamfeel.label: Feel like part of your team, how much
teamfeel.question:
ASK IF CURRENTLY IN PAID WORK AT F17a OR F18 (IF 01 AT F17a OR F18 = 1)
The next few questions are about the team in which you work.
CARD 79 | If you work in a team, how much do you feel like part of your team? | Please choose a number from 0 to 10, where 0 means not at all and 10 means completely.

values.category: I don't work in a team

wrkextra.label: Take on extra responsibilities at work without being paid more
wrkextra.question:
ASK IF RESPONDENT DID NOT REPORT NOT WORKING IN TEAM AT G51 (IF G51 = 00, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 77, 88)
CARD 80 | If needed, how willing would you be to take on extra responsibilities at work without being paid more? | Please choose a number from 0 to 10, where 0 means not at all willing and 10 means completely willing.

colprop.label: Proportion of colleagues based at the same location
colprop.question:
ASK IF CURRENTLY IN PAID WORK AT F17a OR F18 (IF 01 AT F17a OR F18 = 1)
Now let's talk about the colleagues you work with on a regular basis.
CARD 81 | If you have colleagues, what proportion of them are based at the same physical location as you on a normal working day? | INTERVIEWER: If the respondent asks which colleagues to consider, ask them to refer to the colleagues they work with on a regular basis. If the respondent works at more than one location, ask them to think about the location they work at most frequently.

colhlp.label: Colleagues give work-related help, how likely
colhlp.question:
ASK IF RESPONDENT DID NOT REPORT HAVING NO COLLEAGUES AT G53 (IF G53 = 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 77, 88)
CARD 82 | How likely would your colleagues be to give you work-related help or advice, if needed?

colspeak.label: Speak with colleagues in person, how often
colspeak.question: CARD 83 | How often do you speak about work with your colleagues in person? | Please only include occasions where you are physically in the same location.

colcom.label: Communicate with colleagues about work via text, email or messaging apps, how often

colscrn.label: Speak with colleagues about work and see each other on a screen, how often

colphone.question: STILL CARD 83 | How often do you speak about work with your colleagues using a phone or other device? | Please include calls you make or receive, but exclude calls where you and your colleagues see each other on a screen.

c19spwrk.label: Speak with people you work with in person, how often compared with before COVID-19
c19spwrk.question:
ASK IF RESPONDENT DID NOT REPORT HAVING NO LINE MANAGER AT G44 AND NO COLLEAGUES AT G53 (IF G44 = 00, 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 10, 77, 88 OR IF G53 = 01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 77, 88)
